### First Horizon Bank's Jimmy Dunn and Mary Lakey Receive 2026 New Orleans CityBusiness Leadership Awards


September 16, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/903615748/files/doc_news/First-Horizon-Banks-Jimmy-Dunn-and-Mary-Lakey-Receive-2026-New-Orleans-CityBusiness-Leadership-Awards-2026.pdf)


NEW ORLEANS


, Sept. 16, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- First Horizon Bank (NYSE: FHN) (or "First Horizon") announced today that Jimmy Dunn, New Orleans Market President, will receive the New Orleans City Business ICON award, and Mary Lakey, Director of Pricing and Profitability, Corporate Treasury, has been named as one of 2026 New Orleans CityBusiness Women of the Year.


The annual New Orleans CityBusiness ICON and Women of the Year Awards recognize outstanding professionals for their career achievements, leadership and contributions to the Greater New Orleans community.


"We are proud to see Jimmy and Mary recognized by New Orleans CityBusiness for their outstanding achievements and the impact they make today and have made throughout their careers," said Tony Adams, Gulf States Regional President for First Horizon Bank. "Both exemplify the drive, dedication and professionalism that define First Horizon. These honors are well deserved."


As New Orleans Market President for First Horizon Bank, Dunn leads the bank's strategy and client growth for the region. An active member of the New Orleans business community, he focuses on strengthening relationships and supporting local nonprofit and civic organizations to drive economic vitality across the region.


Lakey has built a distinguished career at First Horizon Bank, bringing extensive expertise and strategic insight to her corporate-wide role as Director of Pricing and Profitability in Corporate Treasury. Her contributions are instrumental in supporting client growth across the company.


Dunn and Lakey will be recognized at the 2026 New Orleans CityBusiness ICON and Women of the Year Awards celebration in November.


**About First Horizon**
First Horizon Corp. (NYSE: FHN), with $84.4 billion in assets as of June 30, 2026, is a leading regional financial services company, dedicated to helping our clients, communities and associates unlock their full potential with capital and counsel. Headquartered in Memphis, TN, the banking subsidiary First Horizon Bank operates in 12 states concentrated in the southern U.S. The Company and its subsidiaries offer commercial, private banking, consumer, small business, wealth and trust management, retail brokerage, capital markets, fixed income, and mortgage banking services. First Horizon has been recognized as one of the nation's best employers by Fortune and Forbes magazines and a Top 10 Most Reputable U.S. Bank. More information is available at[www.FirstHorizon.com](https://www.firsthorizon.com/) .
